title: 4.4BSD-Lite 与网络发行版的同款条款
issue: McKusick《Twenty Years of Berkeley Unix》（Open Sources 在线版，一手当事人）：“was released in June 1994 under terms identical to those used for the Networking releases”——1994 年 6 月与“同网络发行版条款”两断言逐字命中；FreeBSD 手册史节另证和解后 Lite 获“declared unencumbered”待遇。题面成立。

title: CSRG 解散与多组并存
issue: 同文两处逐字：“Following the release of 4.4BSD-Lite Release 2, the CSRG was disbanded.”与“the idea of having several groups with different charters ensures that many different approaches will be tried”——解散时点与“多组持章使多种方案得以尝试”的制度安排表述双双命中。

title: 源代码可得性的传统
issue: 同文：“Because the system is released in source form, the best ideas can easily be picked up by other groups.”另及“the power of making the source available to the users. Instead of passively using the system, they actively worked to fix bugs…”——源码可得性使好想法可被他组直接取用之机制由 CSRG 当事人明文，非泛化修辞；四分支皆由此派生亦在同文叙事内。

title: FreeBSD 自述的源流接续
issue: 手册引言章：“FreeBSD is based on the 4.4BSD-Lite release from Computer Systems Research Group (CSRG) at the University of California at Berkeley, and carries on the distinguished tradition of BSD systems development.”——接续 CSRG 与 4.4BSD-Lite、“延续 BSD 系统开发传统”逐字在档。

title: 网络发行版与完整系统的分界
issue: McKusick 文：“Simultaneously, the complete system was released as 4.4BSD-Encumbered, which still required recipients to have a USL source license.”＋4.4BSD-Lite“under terms identical to those used for the Networking releases”——两条发行线与“分界＝是否仍需 USL 源码许可”逐字命中；NetBSD 官方史页谱系图亦并列 4.4BSD-Encumbered 与 4.4BSD Lite 两支。

title: 学术机构的署名约束
issue: OpenBSD 版权政策页载伯克利四条条款全文（含“3. All advertising materials mentioning features or use of this software must display the following acknowledgement…”）并总括“The original Berkeley copyright…imposes only simple and uniform requirements for maintaining copyright notices in redistributed versions and crediting the originator of the material only in advertising”；McKusick 文“subject only to the constraint that the University copyrights remain intact and that the University receive credit when others use the code”互证——“唯一约束＝保留版权与致谢”成立；“学术机构固定于署名位置”为论题层引申，与条款第 3 条致谢义务相合。

title: Net/2 缺失文件的补齐
issue: 主证 McKusick 文：“Within six months of the release, Bill Jolitz had written replacements for the six missing files. He promptly released a fully compiled and bootable system for the 386-based PC architecture which he called 386/BSD.”——“六个文件”“半年内”“可引导”三要素逐字对应（“the release”指同文明载“began shipping in June 1991”的 Net/2）。Jolitz 家族官方站 386bsd.org“Missing Pieces”文补证“finished the missing pieces necessary to make a bootable running kernel”而未载时距——“半年”之数以 McKusick 1999 年回忆为限，正文采用时宜注出处。

title: 匿名 FTP 分发的最初形态
issue: McKusick 文：“Jolitz's 386/BSD distribution was done almost entirely on the Net. He simply put it up for anonymous FTP and let anyone who wanted it download it for free.”——匿名 FTP 与免费下载逐字命中；Lynne Jolitz 自述（telemuse 站，经 Wayback 存档）：“the release was available for download”＋“The original download site got overloaded and mirror sites were set up all over the globe”互证。

title: 维护人力与缺陷积压的错位
issue: McKusick 文：“the demands of keeping a full-time job meant that Jolitz could not devote the time needed to keep up with the flood of incoming bug fixes and enhancements to 386/BSD.”——全职工作与修补洪峰的错位逐字在档；FreeBSD 手册史节“suffering rather severely from almost a year's worth of neglect”补停滞后果一侧。

title: 用户自组织的维护团体
issue: McKusick 文：“within a few months of the release of 386/BSD, a group of avid 386/BSD users formed the NetBSD group to pool their collective resources to help maintain and later enhance the system.”——“数月内”“热心用户”“汇聚资源共同维护并增强”逐字对应；NetBSD 官方史页“…led to the founding of the NetBSD project in 1993”另证建项年份。

title: 386BSD 停滞后的接续者
issue: FreeBSD 手册史节（Hubbard 执笔）：“386BSD was Bill Jolitz's operating system, which had been up to that point suffering rather severely from almost a year's worth of neglect.”＋“they decided to assist Bill by providing this interim ‘cleanup’ snapshot”——“近一年失修”与 FreeBSD 以接续者自任的起点定位逐字在档。

title: 早期采用者的规模与速度
issue: McKusick 文：“Within weeks he had a huge following.”——“数周内聚起大量追随者”逐字命中；Lynne Jolitz 自述另给量级：“an estimated 250,000 downloads from the Internet in the first week”。“后续分叉以此代码为共同起点”与 McKusick 文 BSDI／NetBSD／FreeBSD 皆源于 Net/2 系统的叙事相合。

title: Patchkit 三位协调者的接续
issue: 手册引言章：“The FreeBSD Project had its genesis in the early part of 1993, partially as the brainchild of the Unofficial 386BSDPatchkit's last 3 coordinators: Nate Williams, Rod Grimes and Jordan Hubbard.”——“1993 年上半年”与“最后三位协调者”逐字命中；原文有“partially”（部分缘起）限定，正文宜保留分寸。

title: 临时快照计划的原始目标
issue: 手册引言章：“The original goal was to produce an intermediate snapshot of 386BSD in order to fix a number of problems that the patchkit mechanism was just not capable of solving.”——中间快照目标与补丁机制不能处理的问题两因逐字在档。

title: FreeBSD 命名的来历
issue: 手册引言章：“Those plans came to a rude halt when Bill Jolitz suddenly decided to withdraw his sanction from the project without any clear indication of what would be done instead.”＋“The trio thought that the goal remained worthwhile, even without Bill's support, and so they adopted the name ‘FreeBSD’ coined by David Greenman.”——Jolitz 撤回支持、三人认定目标成立、Greenman 拟名三事逐字在档。

title: Walnut Creek 的分发支持
issue: 手册引言章：“Walnut Creek CDROM not only supported the idea of distributing FreeBSD on CD but also went so far as to provide the project with a machine to work on and a fast Internet connection.”——机器与快速线路两投入逐字命中。

title: 架构独立与 i386 取向的分野
issue: NetBSD 官方史页：“NetBSD's original focus was quality and architecture independence. FreeBSD was formed later with a focus on the i386 PC platform.”——两系取向对照逐字命中；“取向差异即时显现”为论题层表述。回指 V52.4.1.5 已证。

title: 补丁散落与 NetBSD 建项
issue: NetBSD 官方史页：“Frustration with the quality of patches in the wild and the inability to get patches included in 386BSD led to the founding of the NetBSD project in 1993.”——补丁散落质量与无法入树两动因及 1993 年建项逐字命中。回指 V52.4.1.3 已证。

title: 分叉年份的文本记载
issue: 分叉年份一手：Theo de Raadt 本人公开信（marc.info 存档）：“RCS file: /cvs/src/Makefile,v revision 1.1 date: 1995/10/18 08:37:01; author: deraadt…That is when the repository was created. That is the official date.”——1995 年 10 月 18 日为官方建库日；OpenBSD 版权政策页“Much of OpenBSD is originally based on and evolved from NetBSD”与 Hansteen 回顾“from a fork of the NetBSD code base in October 1995”补“自 NetBSD 分叉”。所据 NetBSD 具体版本官方页面确实未载，题面存留该限定恰当。

title: 创始人离开 NetBSD 核心组
issue: 双独立一手在档：NetBSD 官方邮件档（Adam Glass，1994-12-23）：“On December 20, Theo de Raadt was asked to resign from the NetBSD Project by the remaining members of ‘core’.”；Theo 自存 coremail 档首件（Chris Demetriou 落款 Tue, 20 Dec 1994）：“We request that you resign from the NetBSD core team…”——日期与“要求辞职”逐字命中；“随后另立项目”由 coremail 自述（“the day OpenBSD was formed”）与 1995 年建库日衔接。

title: 公开讨论与公众审视
issue: 目标页：“Provide the best development platform possible. Provide full source access to developers and users, including the ability to look at CVS tree changes directly.”（开放审视的开发环境）＋首页“Our efforts emphasize portability, standardization, correctness, proactive security and integrated cryptography”（质量与安全）；Hansteen（OpenBSD 开发者，APNIC）：“From the very start, the OpenBSD project has been running a code audit of the entire tree, focusing on code correctness and security.”与“growing up in the public…since 1995 (transparent process, development discussions on public tech@ mailing list)”补“自始如此”。注：“初始动机”无建项当时官方文告直证，系由项目现行自述与开发者回顾合成，正文宜作回溯表述。

title: 技术优劣作为决策依据
issue: 目标页：“Be as politics-free as possible; solutions should be decided on the basis of technical merit.”——“尽量无政治”“依技术优劣”逐字命中。

title: 半年发行节律的成文规定
issue: 目标页：“Make a release approximately every six months.”——“大约每六个月作一次发行”逐字命中。

title: 开发者专属集会的列项
issue: 目标页：“Focus on being developer-oriented in all senses, including holding developer-only events called hackathons.”——“仅限开发者参加的 hackathon”逐字命中。

title: FreeBSD 4.8 分支点的记载
issue: 官方史页：“DragonFly BSD was forked from FreeBSD 4.8 in June of 2003, by Matthew Dillon.”——年份月份与底本逐字命中；Hsu 论文“forked off the RELENG_4 branch of FreeBSD on June 16, 2003”更精细（回指 V52.4.3.3 已证）；该页确未载选点理由，题面限定成立。

title: 4.x 系列延续者的自我定位
issue: 官方史页：“The project was originally billed as ‘the logical continuation of the FreeBSD 4.x series’, as quoted in the announcement, but this description has long since become obsolete.”——初始自称与官方判为过时两句逐字在档；Dillon 公告“It is the intent of this project to take over development of the 4.x tree”为“4.x 延续”之原始出处。

title: 集群内核目标的原始设定
issue: 官方史页：“The ultimate goal of the DragonFly project at its inception was to provide native clustering support in the kernel.”＋“This original design direction, although no longer the primary goal of the DragonFly project, has influenced many of the design decisions made in the intervening years.”——原始集群目标与“塑造早期重构方向”逐字在档。

title: 缓存一致性目标的降级
issue: 官方史页：“While full cache coherency is no longer a top level goal, filesystem coherency is, and that direction continues to guide the project in a number of ways.”——全缓存一致性降级与文件系统一致性保留两半逐字命中。

title: 另一条道路的公开表述
issue: 官方首页：“DragonFly provides an opportunity for the BSD base to grow in an entirely different direction from the one taken in the FreeBSD, NetBSD, and OpenBSD series.”——“不同于另三家”的自陈逐字命中。

title: 与旧有包袱切割的取向
issue: 官方首页：“This community has no reservation about cutting ties with legacy when it makes sense, preferring a pragmatic, no-nonsense approach to development of the system.”——“合理时不惜与旧包袱切割”“务实取向”逐字命中。

title: 互联网协作的最早实践
issue: NetBSD 官方 About 页：“NetBSD was one of the first major open source projects to be organized collaboratively entirely over the internet, using a network-connected version control system to develop the OS and organizing the project over email since 1993.”——“最早完全经互联网协作的大型开源项目之一”“网络版本控制”“邮件”“自 1993”四要素逐字对应。

title: 宽松许可作为自述强项
issue: 手册引言章强项清单首项：“Liberal Open Source license, which grants the rights to freely modify and extend its source code and incorporate it in both Open Source projects and closed products without imposing restrictions typical to copyleft licenses…”——“宽松许可列首项强项”与“允许修改、扩展并进入闭源产品”逐字命中。

title: 内核与用户空间同树维护
issue: 手册引言章：“Simple and consistent repository structure and build system - FreeBSD uses a single repository for all of its components, both kernel and userspace.”——单一仓库同载内核与用户空间逐字命中。

title: 志愿者共同体的组织形态
issue: OpenBSD 首页：“OpenBSD is developed entirely by volunteers. The project's development environment and developer events are funded through contributions collected by The OpenBSD Foundation.”——完全志愿者开发与经费用途逐字命中；donations 页“maintain our build/development infrastructure, pay our electrical/internet costs, and allow us to continue operating very productive developer hackathon events”补用途明细。

title: 可移植性作为项目目标
issue: NetBSD 官方 About 页“The NetBSD Project's goals”恰列五条（well designed stable fast／avoids encumbering licenses／portable／interoperates／conforms to standards），第三条即“provides a portable system, which runs on many hardware platforms”——“五项项目目标之一”与可移植性逐字对应。

title: 同源同类的自我归类
issue: DragonFly 官方首页：“DragonFly belongs to the same class of operating systems as other BSD-derived systems and Linux. It is based on the same UNIX ideals and APIs and shares ancestor code with other BSD operating systems.”——“同类”“相同 UNIX 理念与 API”“共享祖先代码”逐字命中。

title: FreeBSD 与 NetBSD 的取向差异
issue: NetBSD 官方史页：“NetBSD's original focus was quality and architecture independence. FreeBSD was formed later with a focus on the i386 PC platform.”——1993 年分道与两系取向逐字在档。回指 V52.4.1.5 已证。

title: DragonFly 的方向差异自述
issue: DragonFly 官方首页：“…grow in an entirely different direction from the one taken in the FreeBSD, NetBSD, and OpenBSD series.”——逐字命中；回指本卷 1.5.5 已证。

title: 共同目标的分类尝试
issue: 目标页：“Obviously, each developer working on OpenBSD has their own aims and priorities, but it is possible to classify the goals we all share”——各有目标与尝试分类共同目标逐字命中。

title: 抢在他人之前修安全
issue: 目标页：“Pay attention to security problems and fix them before anyone else does. (Try to be the #1 most secure operating system.)”——逐字命中；题面“四家权重排序未获对称材料”之限定与实测一致（其余三家无同位目标页）。

title: 机器无关源码树的取向
issue: 目标页：“Work towards a very machine independent source tree. Support as many different systems and hardware as feasible.”——逐字命中；与 NetBSD 口号同型但确系 OpenBSD 目标页原文，未误置。

title: 对商业取用的公开鼓励
issue: 目标页：“We want to make available source code that anyone can use for ANY PURPOSE, with no restrictions. We strive to make our software robust and secure, and encourage companies to use whichever pieces they want to. There are commercial spin-offs of OpenBSD.”——“鼓励公司取用其所需部件”逐字命中；惟“条件落在许可与安全声明”未见于该页原文（页内仅有准入侧“acceptable licenses”与自期“robust and secure”），建议内容批按原文表述或删条件从句。

title: 诉讼后的代码基重建
issue: 三腿皆有各系一手：FreeBSD 手册 1.3.1“literally re-inventing itself from a completely new and rather incomplete set of 4.4BSD-Lite bits…a huge task to merge all the FreeBSD developments into 4.4BSD-Lite”；NetBSD 官网 about 页“The NetBSD code was originally derived from 4.4BSD Lite2 from the University of California, Berkeley.”；BSDi 自家和解公告（Kolstad，1994-02-06，TUHS 存档）“BSDI has agreed to substitute a port of the University of California's forthcoming new release to be known as 4.4 BSD(Lite) for BSD/386.”。

title: 诉讼作为分流的外部变量
issue: 引文取自 USL 第一次修正诉状（1992-07-24，案号 92-1667 DRD，存 DMR 档案）第 9 段：“BSDI's development and distribution of its BSD/386 Source product constitutes federal copyright infringement and misappropriation of trade secrets on the part of BSDI.”，第 2 段并称产品“based upon, copied from, or derived from USL's proprietary and copyrighted UNIX operating system software”。精度注记：该件文内自称“FIRST AMENDED COMPLAINT”，初版诉状仅含 Lanham 虚假广告与不正当竞争主张，版权与商业秘密系修正诉状加入——正文引用宜注明诉状版本。

title: 偶然事件在编年中的分量
issue: 手册 1.3.1 逐字：“Those plans came to a rude halt when Bill Jolitz suddenly decided to withdraw his sanction from the project without any clear indication of what would be done instead.”；前文明载原计划为“interim 'cleanup' snapshot”，其后“The trio thought that the goal remained worthwhile, even without Bill's support”——撤回支持致清理快照计划转为独立项目成立。

title: 派生系统的再分叉链条
issue: NetBSD 史页逐字：“NetBSD has also been used as the basis of other derivatives, including Apple's Rhapsody and Force 10's FTOS”；产品页另载 Brocade“Rhapsody switch…central CPU, which is a PowerPC processor running the NetBSD operating system”与“Force10 Networks…NetBSD is the base for their FTOS software”。精度注记：史页之 Rhapsody 指 Apple Rhapsody，产品页之 Rhapsody 指 Brocade 交换机——NetBSD 官方两处指称不同，正文宜注明。

title: 松散同心圆式的组织承接
issue: 现行 FreeBSD 手册 1.3.3 逐字存留：“In summary, our development model is organized as a loose set of concentric circles.”——3.x—4.x 旧版手册同句（docs-archive.freebsd.org 3.2-RELEASE handbook5），自述成立。

title: 分叉之后的合流路径
issue: 双向均有一手：FreeBSD 手册“a huge task to merge all the FreeBSD developments into 4.4BSD-Lite”（分叉改进并入 Lite 基座）；NetBSD 史页“NetBSD has imported changes from other sources, including 4.4BSD Lite”，同页谱系图示 4.4BSD Lite2 分流至 FreeBSD 2.2、NetBSD 1.3、OpenBSD 2.3、BSD/OS 3.0、Rhapsody。精度注记：“多数”未量化，正文宜作定性表述。

title: 非发行版的自我定位
issue: about 页逐字：“It isn't a 'distribution' or variant, but has evolved over several decades to be a complete and unique operating system in the BSD family.”

title: 标准跟进作为目标条目
issue: goals 页逐字：“Track and implement standards (ANSI, POSIX, parts of X/Open, etc.)”

title: 安全目标在五项中的排序
issue: 官网首页逐字：“Our efforts emphasize portability, standardization, correctness, proactive security and integrated cryptography.”——五项并列与题面完全对应；注意 FAQ 1 作四项简版（“Our goals place emphasis on correctness, security, standardization, and portability.”），正文宜引首页版本。

title: 虚拟内核的用途界定
issue: 官网首页逐字：“Virtual kernels provide the ability to run a full-blown kernel as a user process for the purpose of managing resources or for accelerated kernel development and debugging.”

title: 通用用途目标的措辞
issue: 手册 1.3.2 逐字：“The goals of the FreeBSD Project are to provide software that may be used for any purpose and without strings attached.”

title: 使用群体的三分画法
issue: about 页目标总结逐字：“In summary: The NetBSD Project provides a freely available and redistributable system that professionals, hobbyists, and researchers can use in whatever manner they wish.”

title: 开发环境经费的出处
issue: 官网首页逐字：“The project's development environment and developer events are funded through contributions collected by The OpenBSD Foundation.”

title: 开发重心的两条分流
issue: 官网史页逐字：“From 2009 onward many developers have focused on SMP scalability while others have put an emphasis on new feature development and driver porting.”

title: 捐助与项目存续的关系
issue: 官网首页逐字：“Contributions ensure that OpenBSD will remain a vibrant and free operating system.”（vibrant and free 即活力与免费属性）

title: 商业渠道对存续的支撑
issue: 手册 1.3.1 逐字：“Walnut Creek CDROM not only supported the idea of distributing FreeBSD on CD but also went so far as to provide the project with a machine to work on and a fast Internet connection. Without Walnut Creek CDROM's almost unprecedented degree of faith in what was, at the time, a completely unknown project, it is quite unlikely that FreeBSD would have gotten as far, as fast, as it has today.”

title: 国际共同体的协作半径
issue: about 页逐字：“NetBSD is an entirely free and open-source UNIX-like operating system developed by an international community.”

title: pkgsrc 外包与资源汇聚
issue: 官网史页逐字：“This resulted in the adoption of the pkgsrc framework for management of all non-base-system third-party applications in order to pool our resources with other BSD projects using this framework.”——注意系第一阶段（2007 年前）口径；现行 DragonFly 已改用 dports（官网首页“DragonFly leverages the dports system”），正文宜注明时代。

title: 受支持平台的清单构成
issue: 四平台名与 OpenBSD plat.html 官方支持清单逐一对应（官方列 alpha、amd64、arm64、armv7、hppa、i386、landisk、luna88k、macppc、octeon、powerpc64、riscv64、sparc64 十三席）；题面未点系属，按端口命名（riscv64、macppc）当系 OpenBSD——FreeBSD 用 riscv、NetBSD 用 evbarm，命名不合。

title: 旧硬件支持的长期承诺
issue: about 页“Why use NetBSD?”节逐字：“There's long-term backwards compatibility to even the earliest NetBSD releases without compromising on feature like 64-bit time. We intend to keep these systems running long after Year 2038.”——承诺属实；但该句在自述承诺段而非“The NetBSD Project's goals”清单，“写进目标”宜放宽为自述承诺。

title: 未解决问题在优先级中的位置
issue: goals 页目标清单逐字：“Do not let serious problems sit unsolved.”；题面“问题积压本身构成优先级判据”系引申，原文仅列为目标条目。

title: TCP/IP 性能作为首项强项
issue: 手册 1.2 强项清单共九项，首项为“Liberal Open Source license”，TCP/IP 列第二：“Strong TCP/IP networking - FreeBSD implements industry standard protocols with ever increasing performance and scalability.”——“性能与可扩展性持续提升”逐字吻合（ever increasing performance and scalability），但“首项”与清单次序相悖。〔已采纳落账 2026-10-31；D3 适配后定题：TCP/IP 网络列入手册强项清单〕
suggested_title: TCP/IP 网络作为 FreeBSD 手册列举的主要强项

title: ARM 平台的支持方式
issue: about 页逐字：“ARM hardware support for a wide range of open, low-cost, and high-end devices…Entirely in the mainline kernel, supported by a single image, and maintained by NetBSD developers with long-term support in mind.”

title: 硬件淘汰与平台退役
issue: 官方 ports 页三级 tiers 制逐字：Tier III 移入事由“The reasons can range from lack of community interest to the hardware becoming so rare that it is simply not available any more”并“moved here if they do not complete a build for 6 months”——硬件可得性、社群兴趣、构建状态三因素均有明文。精度注记：“三项裁定”系归纳表述；Tier II 亦有“MI architecture decisions may penalize organic ports”，“并非技术优劣判决”宜作限定。题面未点系属，判据与 NetBSD tiers 制吻合（OpenBSD plat.html 对退役平台仅言“discontinued for various reasons”）。

title: 商业采用与许可前提
issue: 手册 1.3.2 逐字：“Due to the additional complexities that can evolve in the commercial use of GPL software we do, however, prefer software submitted under the more relaxed BSD license when it is a reasonable option to do so.”

title: pkgsrc 在科学计算社群的使用
issue: about 页逐字：“pkgsrc has been widely adopted in the high-performance scientific computing community, including at NASA, and supports other platforms, but NetBSD is prioritized.”

title: 商业分支与主线的并存
issue: goals 页集成条目逐字：“There are commercial spin-offs of OpenBSD.”，同条并言“We want to make available source code that anyone can use for ANY PURPOSE, with no restrictions…encourage companies to use whichever pieces they want to”——商业衍生写入目标文本属实。

title: 经费动机的自我限定
issue: redistribution 页逐字：“We are not in it for the money (we are volunteers!), so we have no desire to keep people from distributing our work.”——志愿者自陈与再分发态度两句齐备。

title: 许可作为准入过滤器
issue: goals 页逐字：“Integrate good code from any source with acceptable licenses. ISC or Berkeley style licences are preferred, the GPL is not acceptable when adding new code, NDAs are never acceptable.”；policy.html 同旨（“OpenBSD strives to provide code that can be freely used, copied, modified, and distributed by anyone and for any purpose”）。

title: 树内 GPL 组件的附加约束
issue: 手册 1.3.2 逐字：“That code in our source tree which falls under the GNU General Public License (GPL) or Library General Public License (LGPL) comes with slightly more strings attached, though at least on the side of enforced access rather than the usual opposite.”——“约束方向是强制开放访问”吻合。

title: 自我描述中的定位句
issue: 官网首页逐字：“DragonFly belongs to the same class of operating systems as other BSD-derived systems and Linux. It is based on the same UNIX ideals and APIs and shares ancestor code with other BSD operating systems.”

title: 名称与词源的自我解释
issue: about 页逐字：“The 'Net' in our name was thus chosen as a tribute to the Internet.”

title: 共同体气质的自我刻画
issue: 官网首页逐字：“The DragonFly BSD community is made up of users and developers that take pride in an operating system that maintains challenging goals and ideals.”

title: 技术强项清单的写法
issue: 手册 1.2 强项清单第 5 项逐字：“Over 30 thousand prebuilt packages for all supported architectures, and the Ports Collection which makes it easy to build customized ones.”，1.3.4 又言“There are about 37000 ports”——可计量项入列属实（清单第 5 项，非首项）。

title: 安全成绩的宣示方式
issue: 官网首页逐字：“Only two remote holes in the default install, in a heck of a long time!”

title: 制品作为影响的例证
issue: 官网首页逐字：“As an example of the effect OpenBSD has, the popular OpenSSH software comes from OpenBSD.”；题面后半“四家比较频次未获统计”为方法论自注，无需外部核。

title: 四分法的解释范围
issue: NetBSD 史页逐字：“NetBSD took its roots from the original UCB 4.3BSD via the Net/2 release and 386BSD.”——与题面链条完全一致；同页谱系图自 V6 经 4.3BSD、Net/2、386BSD 至各分支。

title: 分类与自我描述的错位
issue: 事实锚点已证：FAQ 1 逐字“OpenBSD is a complete system, intended to be kept in sync. It is not a kernel plus utilities that can be upgraded separately from each other.”，首页亦自述“produces a FREE, multi-platform 4.4BSD-based UNIX-like operating system”——“错位”论断为该节分析框架，锚点文本成立。

title: HAMMER 的引入时点
issue: 官网史页逐字：“HAMMER saw its first light of day in July 2008 with the DragonFly 2.0 release.”——2008 年 7 月随 2.0 首次面世成立。

title: NetBSD 基金会的法人与商标
issue: about 页逐字：“incorporated in the United States as a tax-exempt corporation (under Section 501(c)(3) of the US Internal Revenue Code)…owns the trademark of the word 'NetBSD'”；foundation 页补“incorporated in the State of Delaware”与“a non-profit organisation as per section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code”。

title: 类 UNIX 标签下的平台清单
issue: 手册 1.2 首句逐字：“FreeBSD is an Open Source, standards-compliant Unix-like operating system for x86 (both 32 and 64 bit), ARM, AArch64, RISC-V, POWER, and PowerPC computers.”——六平台族逐一对应。

title: 口号与使命的对应
issue: 口号逐字见于 7.8 发行说明 INSTALL.amd64：“The OpenBSD team strives to achieve what is called a 'secure by default' status…This 'secure by default' goal is achieved by taking a proactive stance on security.”。精度注记：OpenBSD 无统一“手册”，FAQ 1 未用此语——“手册称”宜改指发行说明（INSTALL）文档；“最小攻击面”对应官方演示口径（openbsd.org/papers 演示文稿，本会话未取正文未引）。题面后半“口号本身不是分类证据”为方法论自注。

title: 统一构建系统的开放接口
issue: 手册 1.2 逐字：“Simple and consistent repository structure and build system - FreeBSD uses a single repository for all of its components, both kernel and userspace. This, along with an unified and easy to customize build system and a well thought out development process makes it easy to integrate FreeBSD with build infrastructure for your own product.”——单库统一、易定制、便于接入自有产品构建基础设施逐字命中；build(7) 补定制接口：“The default components included in the build are specified in the file /etc/src.conf”与“LOCAL_DIRS…a list of additional directories relative to the root of the source tree to build as part of the everything target.”。

title: 可重复构建的发行形态
issue: NetBSD 官方 about 页逐字：“NetBSD is distributed as a set of fully reproducible binaries”＋“Releases are cut periodically from stable branches after a period of testing and are supported for several years.”——发行物＝完全可重复构建的二进制集合，逐字命中。

title: 基础系统与第三方的分界取消
issue: FAQ 1.1 逐字：“OpenBSD is a complete system, intended to be kept in sync. It is not a kernel plus utilities that can be upgraded separately from each other.”；同页：“OpenBSD is distributed with a number of third-party software products”（清单含 X.org、LLVM/Clang、GCC、Perl 等）＋“The OpenBSD team often patches third-party products, typically to improve the security or quality of the code.”——第三方组件并入基础系统后按整体同步开发与打补丁成立。⚠️“分界取消”系引申：同页另有“OpenBSD maintains a ports tree to provide third-party software”，ports 侧分界明确，正文宜限定于基础系统内部的集成方式。

title: 第三方软件的接入方式
issue: DragonFly 首页逐字：“A major crux of any open source operating system is third party applications. DragonFly leverages the dports system to provide thousands of applications in source and binary forms.”——以 dports 提供第三方应用逐字命中；⚠️“接入方式决定基础系统边界的宽窄”为比较性引申。官方史页另载更早阶段“This resulted in the adoption of the pkgsrc framework for management of all non-base-system third-party applications”，正文可补演进。

title: 手册页作为系统构件
issue: 手册 1.2 逐字：“…there are also the man(1) pages, not only for userspace daemons, utilities, and configuration files, but also for kernel driver APIs (section 9) and individual drivers (section 4).”——手册页与内核驱动接口文档（第 9、4 节）并入系统文档面逐字命中；build(7) 载“/usr/doc — system documentation, excluding manual pages”，文档与 src、ports 并列为三大系统源目录，文档作为构件而非附属成立。

title: 源码可得与整体观的衔接
issue: goals 页目标清单第一条逐字：“Provide the best development platform possible. Provide full source access to developers and users, including the ability to look at CVS tree changes directly. Users can even look at our source tree and changes directly on the web!”——首条即向开发者与用户开放完整源码访问＋直接查看 CVS 树改动，逐字命中。

title: 提交者的推送权限
issue: Committer’s Guide 逐字：“Almost all FreeBSD developers have commit rights to one or more repositories.”＋“This section describes the read-write access for committers to push the commits from developers or contributors.”＋“When FreeBSD commit bits are allocated, the areas of the tree where the bit may be used are specified.”——对 Git 仓库的读写推送权与按树区授权修改源码，逐字命中。

title: 补丁审查与匿名提交的排除
issue: OpenBSD 开发者自述（官方 papers，Gwynne《The OpenBSD Culture》）逐字：“you show your fix to people who are knowledgeable in that area - you get their ok and commit it (this bit can take a while)”＋customs 节“peer review”——补丁先经知情人审可、后入树；anoncvs 页两级访问逐字：“There are two levels of source tree access: Read-write access for developers；Read-only access for everyone.”（原文两行列表）——不设匿名提交权限逐字命中。

title: 提交日志的公开投递
issue: mail 页逐字：“Every time a developer commits a change to the OpenBSD CVS tree, a message is mailed out to all the subscribers of these lists, containing the commit comments.”＋“source-changes@openbsd.org: Automated mail of CVS source tree changes in the src, xenocara and www repositories.”——每次提交自动投递公开列表，逐字命中。

title: 缺陷报告入口的开放程度
issue: sendbug(1) 逐字：“sendbug is used to submit problem reports (PRs) to the OpenBSD bugs database.”＋“The content of the PR is not confidential; it is sent out to a public mailing list.”；FAQ 1.1 逐字：“Reporting bugs is one of the most important responsibilities of end users.”——面向任何最终用户、经公开列表投递；与 anoncvs 页“Read-write access for developers／Read-only access for everyone”两级结构对读成立。⚠️“向任何人开放提交”无单句“anyone may submit”原文，系由上述各句合成。

title: 自动化测试的覆盖面
issue: NetBSD about 页逐字：“NetBSD’s kernel and userspace have undergone extensive checks by code sanitizers and automated testing.”——内核与用户空间经代码净化器与自动化测试广泛检查，逐字命中；9.0 公告补清单：“Support for Kernel Address Sanitizer (KASAN), on amd64 and aarch64.”＋“Support for userland sanitizers, with new configurations allowing to run the entire userland stack with sanitizers.”

title: 快照与发行的产出关系
issue: FAQ5 逐字：“Snapshots of the -current branch are made available between formal releases of OpenBSD. These are builds of whatever code is in the tree at the time.”＋“Every six months, -current is tagged and becomes the next release.”——快照与发行同出一树逐字命中；FAQ1：“The OpenBSD team makes a new release approximately every six months, with the target release dates in May and November.”；Theo 2002 论文（官方 papers）：“Frequent snapshots (weekly near release)…Release every 6 months (always on time or early)”。⚠️“每日”官方未直书（论文作近发行期每周；官方快照目录实测按日刷新），正文宜作“定期快照”或注明实测。

title: 默认编译器的更替
issue: 10.0R 发行说明逐字：“On platforms where clang(1) is the default system compiler (such as i386, amd64, arm), GCC and GNU libstdc are no longer built by default.”＋10.0R 公告：“GCC is no longer installed by default on architectures where clang(1) is the default compiler.”——i386、amd64、arm 以 clang 为默认、GCC 不再默认构建，逐字命中。

title: 旧平台上的工具链保留
issue: 10.0R 发行说明逐字：“GCC 4.2.1 and libstdc++ are still built and used by default on pc98 and all other platforms where clang(1) is not the default system compiler.”——pc98 等 clang 未成默认的平台保留 GCC 4.2.1、按平台分步而非一刀切，逐字命中。

title: 基础系统组件的替换
issue: 10.0R 发行说明逐字：“BIND has been removed from the base system. unbound(8), which is maintained by NLnet Labs, has been imported to support local DNS resolution functionality with DNSSEC…With this change, nslookup and dig are no longer a part of the base system.”——BIND 移出、unbound 接替、随附工具清单改变，逐字命中；10.0R 公告另载两条 highlight：“Unbound has been imported to the base system as the local caching DNS resolver.”＋“BIND has been removed from the base system.”

title: GPL 工具链的历史遗留
issue: 版权政策页逐字：“For historical reasons, the OpenBSD base system still includes the following GPL-licensed components: the GNU compiler collection (GCC) with supporting binutils and libraries, GNU CVS, GNU texinfo, the mkhybrid file system creation tool, and the readline library.”——GCC 等 GPL 组件遗留状态明文写入政策，逐字命中。

title: 自由许可工具的替代目标
issue: 政策页紧接上句逐字：“Replacement by equivalent, more freely licensed tools is a long-term desideratum.”——以更自由的等价工具替换 GPL 组件定为长期目标，逐字命中；culture 论文另证“pro-actively replacing GPLed code”。

title: GPL 组件进入基础系统的禁令
issue: 政策页逐字：“no additional software bound by the GPL terms will be considered for inclusion into the OpenBSD base system.”；goals 页同旨逐字：“Integrate good code from any source with acceptable licenses. ISC or Berkeley style licences are preferred, the GPL is not acceptable when adding new code, NDAs are never acceptable.”——双独立一手。

title: UFS 之后的替代选择
issue: hammer(5) 官方手册页逐字：“The HAMMER file system provides facilities to store file system data onto disk devices and is intended to replace ffs(5) as the default file system for DragonFly.”——官方定位为取代 ffs(5)（UFS/FFS）的默认文件系统，逐字命中；正文宜写“ffs(5)（UFS）”对应。

title: 写时复制与快照语义
issue: HAMMER 页逐字：“Because HAMMER2 is a block copy-on-write filesystem”＋“the filesystem is able to create a snapshot trivially simply by copying the volume header’s root block table (4 blockref entries)”；HAMMER2 DESIGN v6（源码树，GitHub 官方镜像）逐字：“HAMMER2 generally implements a copy-on-write block design for the filesystem…Because the design is copy-on-write it can be trivially snapshotted simply by making a copy of the block table we desire to snapshot. Snapshotting the root inode effectively snapshots the entire filesystem”——块级写时复制＋快照由复制根块表完成，双独立一手。

title: 崩溃恢复与 fsck 的取消
issue: HAMMER 页逐字：“HAMMER file systems are immediately available after a crash. There is no fsck.”；hammer.pdf 设计文档同证：“Instant or nearly-instant mount. No fsck needed on crash recovery.”——崩溃后立即可用、不设 fsck，双源逐字。

title: 细粒度历史的保留期
issue: HAMMER 页逐字：“HAMMER retains a fine-grained history. The state of the filesystem can be accessed live on 30-60 second boundaries without having to make explicit snapshots, up to a configurable fine-grained retention time.”；hammer(5) 同证：“by default the resolution of a file’s history is 30-60 seconds until the next prune operation.”——30 至 60 秒粒度、保留期可配置，双源逐字。

title: ZFS 在 NetBSD 的位置
issue: about 页逐字：“Modern storage capabilities - including the ZFS file system, RAIDframe software RAID system, and cgd disk encryption.”——ZFS 与 RAIDframe、cgd 并列列为现代存储能力，逐字命中。

title: OpenZFS 的集成深度
issue: 手册 1.2 逐字：“Fully integrated OpenZFS support, including root-on-ZFS, ZFS Boot Environments, fault management, administrative delegation, support for jails, FreeBSD specific documentation, and system installer support.”——深度集成＋根上 ZFS＋引导环境逐字命中；ZFS 章同证：“The FreeBSD installer can install the system directly onto a ZFS pool, a configuration known as Root-on-ZFS”；features 页专设“ZFS boot environments”节。

title: 默认加固的强度选择
issue: about 页逐字：“including PaX MPROTECT (W^X) enforced globally by default with an option to exclude binaries”——默认全局强制启用并保留排除选项，逐字命中。

title: 沙箱机制的接入范围
issue: 手册 1.2 逐字：“Extensive security features, from the Mandatory Access Control framework to Capsicum capability and sandbox mechanisms.”——从强制访问控制到 Capsicum 能力机制逐字命中；手册安全章 Synopsis 同证分层：“The FreeBSD system comes with multiple layers of security”。

title: 未就绪特性的推迟
issue: Theo 2002 开发流程论文（官方 papers）逐字：“Features dropped if not release-worthy”＋“Tree locked before release (fixes only)”＋“Features get left out”（实例：“i386 APM delayed by one release”）——未达发行线的特性舍弃推迟、不为特性延后发行，逐字命中。

title: 发行前的全平台构建门槛
issue: 平台页逐字：“Official support means that the release install media is known to work, that the architecture can self-compile itself, and that most of the basic tools exist on the architecture.”——官方支持的定义即发行媒介可用（含启动）＋架构自编译。⚠️“定版前全架构构建并启动”的流程门槛表述系引申（未有一句流程原文）；且 musess 2002 论文另有“Some architectures left out if unstable”（不稳定架构可整体排除）——正文宜按“官方支持”定义表述。

title: 性能与可靠性的对等主张
issue: 手册 1.2 逐字：“FreeBSD offers performance and reliability on par with other Open Source and commercial offerings, combined with cutting-edge features not available anywhere else.”——“on par”对等表述逐字命中；⚠️同句后半仍含“cutting-edge features not available anywhere else”领先表述，对等与领先并存，正文引用宜整句照录。

title: SMP 重构的稳定性收益
issue: DragonFly 首页逐字：“A combination of intentional simplification of certain classes of locks to make more expansive subsystems less prone to deadlocks, and the rewriting of nearly all the original codebase using algorithms designed specifically with SMP in mind, has resulted in an extremely stable, high-performance kernel that is capable of efficiently using all cpu, memory, and I/O resources thrown at it.”——有意简化锁类别换取子系统抗死锁、稳定性收益出自设计取舍，逐字命中。

title: 内核子系统的清理幅度
issue: 官方史页逐字：“DragonFly BSD has been going through rapid and ever increasing development since the fork. One of the important works included the simplification and general cleanup of the majority of the kernel subsystems.”＋“During the first major phase of the project, which lasted until early 2007, the DragonFly project focused on rewriting most of the major kernel subsystems to implement required abstractions…”——分叉后首批工作对多数内核子系统简化清理，逐字命中。

title: 重构意图与实际收益的偏差
issue: 官方史页紧接上句逐字：“This work was originally intended to support single system image clustering, but has had the effect of making the kernel much more reliable, understandable and easily maintainable.”——清理原为单系统映像集群服务、实际收益落在可靠可解易维护，逐字命中。

title: 创新清单的编年体例
issue: innovations 页逐字：“This is a list of software and ideas developed or maintained by the OpenBSD project, sorted in order of approximate introduction.”——以近似引入时间为序编列，逐字命中。

title: pf 对 ipf 的替换
issue: innovations 页逐字：“pf(4), pfctl(8), pflogd(8), authpf(8), ftp-proxy(8): Written by Daniel Hartmeier and Henning Brauer as a replacement for the non-free ipf by Darren Reed. Imported June 24, 2001 and first released with OpenBSD 3.0.”——作者（Hartmeier、Brauer）、动机（替换）、非自由 ipf、Darren Reed 四要素逐字命中。

title: 内存保护机制的首次落地
issue: innovations 页逐字：“W^X: First used for sparc, sparc64, alpha, and hppa in OpenBSD 3.3. Strictly enforced by default since OpenBSD 6.0…”——3.3 在四平台（sparc、sparc64、alpha、hppa）首次启用，逐字命中。

title: 版本控制系统的两次迁移
issue: ⚠️SVN 半句跨月错位（回指已证）：Subversion Primer 逐字（title-review/V52.tsv V52.5.1.1 同 URL 已取回）：“The FreeBSD source repository switched from CVS to Subversion on May 31st, 2008. The first real SVN commit is r179447.”——切换日为 2008 年 5 月 31 日，论题“2008 年 6 月”跨月。Git 半句确证：官方季度报告逐字：“The doc and src trees were migrated from Subversion to Git at the end of 2020”＋“The whole migration completed on April 6th. Since 2021Q2, the ports quarterly branch is created in Git repository only.”——源码与文档库 2020 年底迁 Git、Ports 2021 年 4 月 6 日跟进。建议论题改“2008 年 5 月底（5 月 31 日）转 SVN”。〔已采纳落账 2026-10-31〕〔D3 适配后定题：版本控制系统的两度迁移〕
suggested_title: 版本控制系统的两次迁移：从 CVS 经 SVN 到 Git

title: 正确性在目标中的位次
issue: FAQ 1.1“About OpenBSD”逐字：“Our goals place emphasis on correctness, security, standardization, and portability.”——四项并列且含“正确性”，逐字命中；首页另有五项变体（Wave1 已取回：“Our efforts emphasize portability, standardization, correctness, proactive security and integrated cryptography”）。⚠️goals.html 本页目标清单（本批复取全文）并无此四项并列——正文标注出处宜写 FAQ 1.1 或首页，勿写 goals.html。

title: 质量与清洁度的长期积累
issue: about 页逐字：“Over time, its code has found its way into many surprising environments, on the basis of a long history of quality, cleanliness, and stability.”——代码进入众多环境归因于质量、清洁与稳定的长期记录，逐字命中。

title: 完全正确主张的限度
issue: Gabriel《The Rise of Worse is Better》MIT 风格逐字：“Correctness -- the design must be correct in all observable aspects. Incorrectness is simply not allowed.”——“要求设计在所有可观察方面正确、不正确不被允许”逐字命中。

title: 简单优先于正确的让步
issue: 同文 New Jersey（worse-is-better）风格逐字：“Correctness -- the design must be correct in all observable aspects. It is slightly better to be simple than correct.”＋“Simplicity is the most important consideration in a design.”——“承认简单略优于正确”与“实现简单最高优先”逐字命中。

title: 代码审查作为正确性手段

title: 提交者投票通过的章程

title: 核心席位的选举基础

title: 和解条款的免诉承诺

title: 学术源头在治理叙述中的位置
issue: 取证：NetBSD 关于页原句“without the University of California, Berkeley’s Computer Systems Research Group and the many contributors to the Berkeley Software Distributions, the NetBSD Project surely would not exist.”逐字证实；注：页面泛称“Berkeley Software Distributions”，题面“4.4BSD 贡献者”系窄化表述。

title: 现行章程的两年选举周期
issue: 取证：现行章程句“Core elections are held every 2 years, first time September 2000.”；修订章程句“Core Team Elections are held annually.”与生效句“These revised bylaws will take effect in 2028…”——两层周期断言逐字证实。

title: 四周投票的程序安排
issue: 取证：现行章程程序句“1 week to tally active committers wishing to run for core.”与“4 weeks for the actual vote.”——提名一周、投票四周逐字证实。

issue: 取证：现行章程原句“Core members and committers may be ejected by a 2/3 vote of core.”——罢免投票主体为核心自身，题面“罢免权留在核心内部”与原文一致。

title: 提前选举的触发条件

issue: 取证：史页原句“The ultimate goal of the DragonFly project at its inception was to provide native clustering support in the kernel.”与“This original design direction, although no longer the primary goal of the DragonFly project, has influenced many of the design decisions made in the intervening years.”两句逐字证实。

issue: 取证：团队页原句“He has been working on or completed DragonFly projects such as variant symlinks, MPIPE, the slab allocator, the namecache, LWKT, live CD, AMD64 work, and much more, including coordination of projects other contributors have submitted.”；网站与在线资源维护句见 6.5.1 所引——“行政与工程边界不分”成立。

title: 提交者名单的公开程度

title: 提交权限的分域授予

issue: 取证：指南原句“Committers can acquire an additional bit by the usual process of finding a mentor who will propose them to srcmgr, doceng, or portmgr, as appropriate.”逐字证实。

issue: 取证：指南原句“Committers are encouraged to seek review for their work as part of the normal development process, regardless of the area of the tree where the work is occurring.”——注：原文为 encouraged（劝告语气），题面“常规化”成立，正文批宜保留“鼓励”限词。

issue: 取证：现行章程原句“Active committers have made a commit to the tree in the last 12 months.”逐字证实；“自动变动”系对资格定义的解释（章程未设重新认证程序）。

title: 信任撤回的联署机制
issue: 取证：现行章程原句“A petition of 1/3 of active committers can trigger an early election.”逐字证实（属现行章程节）。

issue: 取证：准则页原行“Publication date: 2020-06-09”逐字证实。

issue: 取证：mail.html 原句“Do your homework before you post.”逐字证实——祈使劝告形式相符；例证出自 OpenBSD 礼节段，与本节“四方横向对照”定位一致。

title: 无成文准则者的替代文本

title: 执行机构与文本同设

title: 举报渠道的单一入口
issue: 取证：准则页原句“If you believe someone is violating the code of conduct, we ask that you report it by emailing conduct@FreeBSD.org.”——单一邮箱入口逐字证实。

title: 辱骂性言语的过滤规则
issue: 取证：mail.html 原句“Posts containing bullying or abusive language may also result in a user’s subsequent messages being sent to a moderator for approval.”逐字证实。

issue: 取证：mail.html 原句“Repeat offenders will have their messages silently dropped.”——静默丢弃逐字证实。

title: 争论中的举证要求
issue: 取证：mail.html 原句“All questions should include at least the version of OpenBSD.”与“Any hardware-related questions should mention the platform (i386, amd64, etc.) and provide a full dmesg(8).”两句逐字证实。

title: 观点差异的处理原则
issue: 取证：mail.html 原句“Intelligent people may look at the same set of facts and come to very different conclusions.”逐字证实；“承认差异”原则与同页“Respect differences in opinion and philosophy.”相接。

issue: 取证：mail.html 原句“The OpenBSD lists use spamd(8) and SpamAssassin to keep down the spam volume, but things do sneak through from time to time — deal with it.”逐字证实。

title: 核心席位规模的收缩

issue: 取证：修订章程原句“These revised bylaws will take effect in 2028, unless the Core Team elected in 2026 decides by two-thirds majority vote of the entire Core Team that they will take effect immediately, and announces this decision to the community.”＋状态句“They have not yet entered into force.”——2028 生效与即时生效选项逐字证实。

title: 选举年的轮换节律

title: 外部评估对叙事的检验
issue: media.ccc.de tag 页实测——“A systematic evaluation of OpenBSD's mitigations”、讲者“stein”、活动“36C3: Resource Exhaustion”、2019-12-29、53 min；slides 站 isopenbsdsecu.re 同述；摘要句“pure luck and superstition”未本会话取回（旧树存录），正文引述摘要须再核原文

title: 和解谈判的起止时点
issue: McKusick《Twenty Years of Berkeley Unix》：“By the summer of 1993, settlement talks had started.”“a settlement was finally reached in January 1994.”——原文言“至 1993 年夏已开始”，非确指始于夏；夏至次年 1 月约半年成立，正文宜照“不晚于夏已开始”措辞。

title: 和解条款的实质内容
issue: McKusick：“The result was that three files were removed from the 18,000 that made up Networking Release 2, and a number of minor changes were made to other files.”

title: USL 版权标注的追加
issue: McKusick：“the University agreed to add USL copyrights to about 70 files, although those files continued to be freely redistributed.”

title: 广告条款的撤销日期
issue: FreeBSD 官网 4.4BSD 版权页全文转载 1999-07-22 Hoskins 函：“Effective immediately, licensees and distributors are no longer required to include the acknowledgement within advertising materials.”；OpenBSD 版权政策页：“Berkeley rescinded the 3rd term (the advertising term) on 22 July 1999.”——两个独立一手源。

title: 禁令驳回后的争点收窄
issue: McKusick（Debevoise 法官裁决）：“denied the injunction and threw out all but two of the complaints. The remaining two complaints were narrowed to recent copyrights and the possibility of the loss of trade secrets.”

title: 四款条文的原始句式
issue: NetBSD 再分发页：“This license was used in the University of California, Berkeley's second Berkeley Networking Release and the 4.4BSD Lite software release”；OpenBSD 政策页全文引四款条文并载删减谱系：“Berkeley rescinded the 3rd term … many 3rd-party BSD-style licenses consist solely of the first two terms.”

title: 宽松许可的传播机制
issue: NetBSD 再分发页：Berkeley 式许可“allow licensees … to sell the code, in any form, with or without modification”；McKusick（Net/1 条款）：“A licensee could release the code modified or unmodified in source or binary form with no accounting or royalties to Berkeley.”；FreeBSD FAQ：“free to modify, distribute, and even sell FreeBSD without being required to release your modifications as open source.”

title: 闭源再分发的许可余地
issue: FreeBSD 二款许可文本仅列两项条件（源码／二进制再分发须保留版权声明与免责声明）；OpenBSD 政策页：“The original Berkeley copyright poses no restrictions on private or commercial use of the software and imposes only simple and uniform requirements for maintaining copyright notices in redistributed versions.”

title: 署名与背书的分离
issue: OSI BSD-3-Clause 文本三款分列：第二两款署名义务，第三款“Neither the name of the copyright holder nor the names of its contributors may be used to endorse or promote products derived from this software”——署名与禁背书各成独立条件；注：题面“只要求”未计免责条款之随附义务，正文宜补一句。

title: 许可文本的最短化
issue: OpenBSD 政策页：“putting code under an ISC or two-clause BSD license essentially makes the code as free as it can possibly get.”——上限之说起字；惟原文列改写三种效果（“making the code less free …”或“effectively not changing anything”或“making the license illegal”），“再改措辞只能减少自由”系压缩，正文宜按三情形表述。

title: 修改后不分发的自由
issue: NetBSD 再分发页：“also allows people to modify the work and not distribute it, if they so choose”，且明言“One thing that some people don't realize about Berkeley-style licenses is …”（“常被忽略”有原文对应）；GPL 第 0 条：“Activities other than copying, distribution and modification are not covered by this License.”

title: 代码交换的意愿条件
issue: OpenBSD 政策页逐字：“The ability of a freely redistributable ‘Berkeley’ Unix to move forward on a competitive basis with other operating systems depends on the willingness of the various development groups to exchange code amongst themselves and with other projects.”

title: FreeBSD 材料在 OpenBSD 的可容纳范围
issue: OpenBSD 政策页 FreeBSD 条：“Such material can be included in OpenBSD, while those parts that are subject to GPL or various individual copyright terms that are at odds with the OpenBSD license can not be included in OpenBSD.”

title: OpenBSD 的 ISC 优先
issue: OpenBSD 政策页 ISC 条：“The ISC copyright is functionally equivalent to a two-term BSD copyright with language removed that is made unnecessary by the Berne convention. This is the preferred license for new code incorporated into OpenBSD.”

title: NetBSD 的二句版转换
issue: NetBSD 再分发页：“In 2008, following on from a vote amongst the membership of the NetBSD Foundation … changed its recommended license to be a 2 clause BSD license”；“At the same time, all the code which was contributed to the NetBSD Foundation has been modified to use the new 2-clause NetBSD license.”

title: 背书条款的弃用理由
issue: NetBSD 再分发页：“The members of the NetBSD Foundation (i.e. its developers) no longer considered clause 4 (the ‘endorsement’ clause) to be useful in today's software world.”

title: 许可授予记录的成文条目
issue: FreeBSD Committer's Guide 第 11 节标题“Keeping Track of Licenses Granted to the FreeBSD Project”，正文：“It is clearly sensible to keep a record of any such license grants … core@FreeBSD.org has decided to keep an archive of them”“persistently archived and serve as our permanent record of the license grant”。

title: OpenBSD 基础系统的 GPL 遗留
issue: OpenBSD 政策页 GPL 条：“For historical reasons, the OpenBSD base system still includes the following GPL-licensed components: the GNU compiler collection (GCC) with supporting binutils and libraries, GNU CVS, GNU texinfo, the mkhybrid file system creation tool, and the readline library.”

title: 源码交付义务的对照
issue: GPL-2.0 第 3 条：“Accompany it with the complete corresponding machine-readable source code”或三年书面报价；二款 BSD 文本无对应义务（仅声明保留与免责）。

title: GPL 对商业使用的阻力
issue: OpenBSD 政策页 GPL 条：“it is a condition that is typically unacceptable for commercial use of software.”

title: 自由分享的悖论陈述
issue: OpenBSD 政策页 GPL 条：“it usually ends up hindering free sharing and reuse of code and ideas rather than encouraging it.”——题面“此说本身须加辨析”为本书分析立场，非外部断言，与一手不悖。

title: OpenBSD 基础系统的 GPL 排除
issue: OpenBSD 政策页 GPL 条：“no additional software bound by the GPL terms will be considered for inclusion into the OpenBSD base system.”

title: FreeBSD 对 GPL 的容忍
issue: FreeBSD FAQ（现行版 Q1.3）：“Code in our source tree which falls under the GNU General Public License (GPL) or GNU Library General Public License (LGPL) comes with slightly more strings attached”——注：该句今载 FAQ（旧版手册 Goals 章同文），现行手册正文无此段，正文引证宜写 FAQ。

title: 派生作品的源码义务
issue: OpenBSD 政策页 GPL 条：“The GNU Public License and licenses modeled on it impose the restriction that source code must be distributed or made available for all works that are derivatives”（“及其仿效许可”逐字对应“licenses modeled on it”）；GPL-2.0 第 2 条：“the distribution of the whole must be on the terms of this License”。

title: 商业采用的技术入口
issue: FreeBSD 手册第 1 章：“Strong TCP/IP networking - FreeBSD implements industry standard protocols with ever increasing performance and scalability”“This makes it a good match in both server, and routing/firewalling roles”；同章另载“A list of testimonials from companies basing their products and services on FreeBSD”。

title: 安全设备场景的落点
issue: NetBSD about 页逐字：“NetBSD includes its own native firewall, NPF, and has been used successfully on security-critical networking devices.”

title: 闭源产品中的代码成分
issue: NetBSD 再分发页：“concerned about the old clause 3 (the advertising clause) in the license, to the extent where NetBSD code could not be used in commercial products; the new license means that these concerns are no longer valid.”

title: 商业分支的合法空间
issue: OpenBSD 政策页：“OpenBSD as a whole is freely redistributable, but some optional components may not be.”；FreeBSD FAQ：“free to modify, distribute, and even sell FreeBSD”——整体可售而可选组件受限的界分逐字在案，“商业分支”为由该句引申的采用面框架，正文宜标明引申层次。

title: 商用内嵌与资助的脱节
issue: OpenSSH 官网主页逐字：“OpenSSH is incorporated into many commercial products, but very few of those companies assist OpenSSH with funding.”

title: 学术用途与商业用途的重叠
issue: FreeBSD 手册第 1 章以并列表呈多类用途：“Here is just a sampling of some of the applications in which people are currently using FreeBSD”（Internet Services、Education and Research、Networking、Embedded、Desktop、Software Development 并列），兼载公司背书句与学生研究句；“专业、爱好与研究”三分系本书归纳，边界不互斥由并列结构自证。

title: pf 的替代性起源
issue: Hartmeier pf 论文（USENIX 2002）：“It was removed after its license turned out to be incompatible with OpenBSD's goal of providing software that is free to use, modify and redistribute in any way for everyone”“While an acceptable Open Source license was a prerequisite for any replacement, we used this opportunity to develop a new packet filter that employed optimized data structures and algorithms to achieve good performance”——许可动机与技术动机并呈；pf FAQ 载作者与 3.0 起入 GENERIC。

title: OpenSSH 的分叉起点
issue: OpenSSH 史页：“OpenSSH is a derivative of the original free ssh 1.2.12 release from Tatu Ylönen”“As of that time, most OpenSSH development had been done by Aaron Campbell, Bob Beck, Markus Friedl, Niels Provos, Theo de Raadt, and Dug Song”；portable README：“OpenSSH was created by Aaron Campbell, Bob Beck, …”——注：直接分叉点为 Grönvall 之 OSSH（1.2.12 衍生，史页“immediately fork from the OSSH release”），正文宜注一笔。

title: 可移植版本的双轨发行
issue: portable README：“This is the port of OpenBSD's excellent OpenSSH to Linux and other Unices”“This port consists of the re-introduction of autoconf support, PAM support, EGD/PRNGD support and replacements for OpenBSD library functions that are (regrettably) absent from other unices”；史页载原生侧“the goal being simpler source code”。

title: NetBSD 许可条款与伯克利许可的相容
issue: OpenBSD 政策页 NetBSD 条逐字：“The general NetBSD license terms are compatible with the Berkeley license and permit such use. Material subject only to the general NetBSD license can generally be included in OpenBSD.”

title: 代码外流的准入门槛
issue: OpenBSD 政策页：“Material with Berkeley copyrights, or copyrights closely adhering to the Berkeley model can generally be included in OpenBSD.”

title: OpenSSH 的开发归属与许可
issue: OpenSSH 官网主页逐字：“OpenSSH is developed by a few developers of the OpenBSD Project and made available under a BSD-style license.”

title: 捐助经基金会的接收
issue: OpenSSH 主页：“Contributions towards OpenSSH can be sent to the OpenBSD Foundation”；OpenBSD 捐助页：“contributions are primarily managed by the OpenBSD Foundation”“This ecosystem is all handled under the same funding umbrella.”

title: 无产权负担发行的由来
issue: OpenBSD 政策页逐字：“OpenBSD can exist as it does today because of the example set by the Computer Systems Research Group at Berkeley and the battles which they and others fought to create a Unix source distribution un-encumbered by proprietary code and commercial licensing.”

title: 非营利资格的缺位
issue: DragonFly 捐助页：“DragonFly is not yet incorporated as a non-profit”“meaning no tax benefit is available for donating time or goods to the project”。

title: 捐助渠道的机构化
issue: OpenBSD 基金会页：“The Foundation needs contributions from Individuals and Companies to support its efforts”；捐助页：“a chronological list of people and organizations who contributed direct to OpenBSD, OpenSSH, and our related projects”。

title: 提交审查的常规要求
issue: FreeBSD Committer's Guide 逐字：“Committers are encouraged to seek review for their work as part of the normal development process, regardless of the area of the tree where the work is occurring.”

title: 回报预期的自我克制
issue: FreeBSD FAQ（12.0 档案版 Q1.3）：“would certainly not mind a little financial compensation now and then, but we definitely do not insist on it”“our first and foremost ‘mission’ is to provide code to any and all comers, and for whatever purpose”；另 ISC 授予句“Permission to use, copy, modify, and distribute this software for any purpose with or without fee is hereby granted”（OpenSSH LICENCE）。

title: 许可取向与伯克利精神的接续
issue: OpenBSD 政策页：“OpenBSD strives to provide code that can be freely used, copied, modified, and distributed by anyone and for any purpose. This maintains the spirit of the original Berkeley Software Distribution.”

title: 自由使用四项动作的界定
issue: OpenBSD 政策页：“freely used, copied, modified, and distributed by anyone and for any purpose”——四动作与“任何人、任何目的”逐字在案；goals 页另载“ANY PURPOSE, with no restrictions”。

title: 许可取舍的务实原则
issue: NetBSD 再分发页：“We are pragmatic, however, and will include software with different license terms”……“if it significantly improves the quality of the system.”——逐字对应。

title: 作者观点与项目政策的切分
issue: FreeBSD 二款许可模板附观点句：“The views and conclusions contained in the software and documentation are those of the authors and should not be interpreted as representing official policies”（句末指明为 FreeBSD Project 之政策）。

title: 许可与商标的分工
issue: FreeBSD 商标页：“FreeBSD is a registered trademark of The FreeBSD Foundation”“The FreeBSD Logo is a trademark of The FreeBSD Foundation”；基金会条款页载商用标记须“explicit written permission from the Foundation”——许可管代码（二款许可文本）、商标管名称系跨官方文件之分工，无单页合述句，正文宜分引两处。

title: 版权的自动取得要件
issue: OpenBSD 政策页逐字：“Because copyrights arise from the creation of a work, rather than through a registration process, there needs to be a practical way to extend permission to use a work beyond what might be allowed by ‘fair use’ provisions of the copyright laws.”

title: 捐助经费的用途界限
issue: OpenBSD 基金会页：“The Foundation uses all funds it receives to fund infrastructure costs for the projects”“developer events and initiatives - typically these are OpenBSD hackathons”；捐助页：“maintain our build/development infrastructure, pay our electrical/internet costs”“continue operating very productive developer hackathon events”。

title: 可考与不可考的界线
issue: OpenSSH 主页逐字：“OpenSSH is incorporated into many commercial products, but very few of those companies assist OpenSSH with funding.”——取用规模与资助记录不相称之直接文本。

title: 捐助页的公开征集
issue: OpenBSD 捐助页：“The OpenBSD Foundation collects donations by Cheque, Bank Draft, PayPal, PayPal recurring, or Benevity.”并载支票邮寄地址与硬件渠道；基金会页：“Please see our Donations Page for information on how to contribute.”

title: 代码回流的计量困难
issue: NetBSD 再分发页：“Third parties are encouraged to change the license on any files which have a 4-clause license contributed to the NetBSD Foundation to a 2-clause license. We would also encourage you to inform us about these files, so that we can continue to track the many places in which NetBSD is used.”——鼓励申报而无强制登记；四款 BSD／GPL 文本均无申报义务条款，跟踪因此不可完备。

title: 个别版权条件的授权记录
issue: OpenBSD 政策页 NetBSD 条逐字：“In the past, NetBSD has included material copyrighted by individuals who have imposed license conditions beyond that of the general NetBSD license, but granted the NetBSD Foundation license to distribute the material.”

title: 捐助名单的收录规则
issue: DragonFly 捐助页逐字：“We list donors here but we don't link back; this is not for advertising.”

title: 内容分发网络的基座选型
issue: FreeBSD 基金会 Netflix 个案页：“Netflix adopted FreeBSD-CURRENT for its Open Connect CDN, aligning closely with the FreeBSD community”——CURRENT 基座与社区对齐逐字命中。

title: 上游树与产品树的对齐
issue: 同页当事人语：“Our tree is almost identical to the upstream FreeBSD tree… it greatly reduces the technical debt we accumulate by keeping our own patches.”——树几乎一致与自持补丁即技术债逐字命中。

title: 内核 TLS 的吞吐收益
issue: 同页：“KTLS is a technology that moves the processing of TLS (Transport Layer Security) from user applications to the operating system kernel.”＋“has enabled Netflix to achieve 400 Gb/s throughput on its CDN servers.”——移入内核与 400 Gb/s 数值逐字命中。

title: 发送文件路径的零拷贝改造
issue: 同页：“Other notable enhancements to FreeBSD by Netflix include asynchronous sendfile operations, which facilitate non-blocking data transfers”＋“With sendfile and kernel TLS, we can eliminate many of these memory bandwidth bottlenecks”＋kTLS 段“avoiding extra copying of the data into and out of user-space just to encrypt it”——异步 sendfile、与 kTLS 配合、消除拷贝均有原文。

title: 概念验证阶段的 10 Gb/s 接口配置
issue: 同页：“In 2012, a proof-of-concept CDN was started on vanilla FreeBSD 9.0-RELEASE and nginx that was provisioned on servers equipped with a single 10 Gbit/s interface.”——年份、原版 9.0-RELEASE、nginx、单 10 Gbit/s 逐字命中。

title: 商用机群的吞吐规模
issue: 同页：“We are one of the biggest sources of traffic on the internet-sending terabits per second, powered by thousands of servers or appliances, all running FreeBSD.”——每秒太比特与数千台设备逐字命中。

title: 平台移植的分层制
issue: NetBSD ports 页：“Ports are classified into three tiers based on the current importance of the architecture and the level of community activity.”——三层分级判据逐字命中；页面实际节题为 Tier I: Focus／Tier II: Organic／Tier III: Life Support。

title: 第一层移植的战略角色
issue: 同页：“Focus ports are the architectures that NetBSD targets as part of its strategy.”＋“Machine independent (MI) changes should benefit these ports.”——战略平台与 MI 改动惠及义务逐字命中；注意官方此处用 should（宜使受益），须与 2.5 的 must（受测）分层表述。

title: 第二层移植的社区维护责任
issue: 同页：“Generally speaking, the port boots and works, but keeping it working is the responsibility of the user community.”——第二层可启动运行、维护归用户社群逐字命中。

title: 第三层移植的退场预警
issue: 同页：“If ports in life support are not shown to be working within a reasonable timeframe, they will be moved to the Attic.”＋“If the port is not reported fixed within the next 6-12 months, it will be moved to the Attic.”——退场时限（6—12 个月）明文，另有“do not complete a build for 6 months”入层时限。

title: 机器无关改动的测试义务
issue: 同页：“MI changes must be tested on at least one of these ports.”——至少一个战略端口受测义务逐字命中（此处为 must）。

title: 十六种 CPU 类型的覆盖
issue: 同页 MACHINE_ARCH 表自述“showing a total of 16 CPU types”——十六种 CPU 类型为页面明载数（截至 2026-10-31 实测）。

title: 审计团队的规模与起始
issue: OpenBSD security.html：“Our security auditing team typically has between six and twelve members”＋“We have been auditing since the summer of 1996.”——六至十二人与 1996 年夏起始逐字命中（typically＝常年口径）。

title: 完全披露原则的先行
issue: 同页：“we believe in full disclosure of security problems”＋“we were probably the first to embrace the concept.”——完全披露先行有原文；注意官方口径带 probably（或系最早）限定，题面“最早”未含此限定，正文引用宜保留。

title: 默认关闭非必要服务
issue: 同页“Secure by Default”节：“All non-essential services are disabled.”——发行默认关闭全部非必要服务逐字命中（该节并载 Novice 用户无需即刻成为安全专家的语境）。

title: 审计产出的新技术
issue: 同页“New Technologies”节：“As we audit source code, we often invent new ways of solving problems.”——审计产出新解法逐字命中。

title: OpenSSH 的外溢效应
issue: OpenBSD 首页实测：“As an example of the effect OpenBSD has, the popular OpenSSH software comes from OpenBSD.”——系页面散文部分唯一影响例证；题面“首要例证”较官方“an example”轻度拔高，正文宜按官方措辞。

title: 远程漏洞计数的口号
issue: 首页实测（2026-10-31）：“Only two remote holes in the default install, in a heck of a long time!”；2007-03-26 独立目记载：“今天在 OpenBSD 网站上看到了他们的一个口号”，其时措辞作“Only two remote holes in the default install, in more than 10 years!”——口号长期置于首页（两时点相距约十九年、措辞随年份微调）两源成立，正文引句须注措辞版本。

title: LWKT 与用户线程两级调度
issue: DragonFly features 页：“The scheduler abstraction has been split up into two layers.”＋“The User Thread Scheduler is a separate scheduler which selects one user thread at a time for each CPU”——LWKT 与用户线程两层逐字命中；“分层是内核实验的起点”为叙事框架语而非页面原文。

title: 虚拟内核的调试用途
issue: 同页：“DragonFly implements a virtual kernel feature for running DragonFly kernels in userland inside DragonFly kernels.”＋“allows DragonFly kernels to be debugged as a userland process”＋“The primary use is to make kernel development easier.”——用户态运行、调试用途与首要用途逐字命中。

title: HAMMER 的默认快照保留
issue: 同页：“All non-temporary HAMMER filesystems in DragonFly by default automatically maintain 60 days worth of 1-day snapshots and 1-day worth of fine-grained (30-second) snapshots.”——六十天日快照＋一天 30 秒细粒度快照逐字命中。

title: 九十万进程的实测记录
issue: 同页：“Process creation, basic operation, and destruction have been tested to 900,000 discrete user processes.”——九十万离散用户进程实测记录逐字命中。

title: 网络栈的全面重写
issue: 同页：“The network subsystem was rewritten pretty much from the ground-up to fully incorporate packet hashes into the entire stack”——近乎重写、包哈希纳入全栈逐字命中；“SMP 目标贯穿整条协议栈”为同一机制段（连接与接口跨可用 CPU 并行）的概括表述。

title: 集群目标的退场记录
issue: DragonFly history 页：“The ultimate goal of the DragonFly project at its inception was to provide native clustering support in the kernel.”＋“While full cache coherency is no longer a top level goal, filesystem coherency is, and that direction continues to guide the project in a number of ways.”——全缓存一致性退场而文件系统一致性保留明文在档。

title: Rhapsody 对 NetBSD 的取用
issue: NetBSD 史页：“NetBSD has also been used as the basis of other derivatives, including Apple's Rhapsody and Force 10's FTOS”；Apple 当事人 Sánchez（USENIX 1999）：“The Mac OS X Server Core OS is a 4.4 BSD system, based on the 4.4 Lite2 release from Berkeley and updates with code from FreeBSD, NetBSD, and OpenBSD.”＋“Apple started a very beneficial technology relationship with NetBSD”——两独立源坐实取用；惟 Apple 自述为 4.4BSD Lite2 基座＋NetBSD 等更新代码，“以 NetBSD 为基座”系 NetBSD 单方口径，正文宜并陈两说。

title: 商业内核的定制深度
issue: Netflix 个案页：“Netflix's customized version of FreeBSD enabled deeper integration and more precise optimization at the kernel level, leading to significant performance improvements.”——内核层深度定制逐字命中；“深度集成是采用方的主要动机”为引申（页面载动机为性能提升）。

title: 闭源再分发的许可通道
issue: NetBSD 官方许可说明页：“they make no requirement that licensees give away the source code, even if they're selling binaries.”——二进制再分发而不公开源码逐字命中；另载“NetBSD code could not be used in commercial products; the new license means that these concerns are no longer valid.”。起草方所引 FreeBSD license 文本仅载 source and binary forms 均可再分发，本复核改引语义更直接的官方页。

title: 修复先行的论坛通用语
issue: security.html：“Statements like This problem was fixed in OpenBSD about 6 months ago have become commonplace in security forums like BUGTRAQ”——论坛常语逐字命中。

title: 苹果对开源位置的自我陈说
issue: opensource.apple.com：“Open source software is at the heart of Apple platforms and developer tools.”——自我陈说逐字命中。

title: 开源发布的两条获取通道
issue: 同页：“You can access the source code for our operating systems and developer tools by downloading releases or browsing Git repositories.”——发布包与 Git 仓库两通道逐字命中。

title: 图形栈自 Linux 的回移
issue: DragonFly history 页：“In 2012 François Tigeot and a dedicated group of helpers began retooling DRM (the graphics subsystem) with an active port from Linux, slowly bringing DragonFly up to modern standards.”——2012 年起自 Linux 移植 DRM 逐字命中；“代码流动并非单向”为比较框架语。

title: 可移植 SSH 的跨系统部署
issue: openssh portable 页：“The OpenSSH provided here is designed to run on the following Unix operating systems:”下逐一列出 AIX／HP-UX／Irix／Linux／NeXT／SCO／SNI/Reliant Unix／Solaris／Digital Unix/Tru64/OSF／macOS／Cygwin，并接“and more are being added all the time.”——名单式陈述逐字命中；openssh.com 经 301 重定向至 openssh.org 同页。

title: NetBSD 对他源改动的引入
issue: NetBSD 史页：“Since then, in addition to the many developments within the project, NetBSD has imported changes from other sources, including 4.4BSD Lite.”——项目内开发之外自他源引入逐字命中。

title: 许可差异造成的取用不对称
issue: OpenBSD policy.html：“Most of Linux is subject to GPL style licensing terms and therefore can not be included in OpenBSD.”＋“Individual components may be eligible, subject to the terms of the originator's copyright notices.”——许可约束取用方向逐字命中；注意个别组件可豁免，另载“no additional software bound by the GPL terms will be considered for inclusion into the OpenBSD base system”。

title: 声卡子系统的 HDA 移植
issue: DragonFly history 页：“At around the same time there was also a concerted effort to upgrade the sound system with a major HDA port from FreeBSD.”——HDA 自 FreeBSD 移植逐字命中；“整体移植”较官方“major port”（大规模移植）微有拔高，正文宜按官方措辞。

title: 版本不同步的协作负担
issue: openssh portable 页：“The portable OpenSSH follows development of the official version, but releases are not synchronized.”——跟随官方开发、发行不同步逐字命中；“协作须承担版本错位成本”为引申半句。

title: 可见影响的记录载体
issue: OpenBSD innovations 页自述：“This is a list of software and ideas developed or maintained by the OpenBSD project, sorted in order of approximate introduction.”——按大致引入序排列为页面明文；实测页面按 Concepts／Functions／Programs and subsystems／Projects maintained by OpenBSD developers outside OpenBSD 四个主题部类分组、条目在部类内排序，题面未提主题分组，正文引用宜补此结构。

title: 发布行为与来源标注的分野
issue: opensource.apple.com 实测：仅有 View releases 与 Git 浏览入口（“You can access the source code for our operating systems and developer tools by downloading releases or browsing Git repositories.”），页面未列任何上游 BSD 项目归属——缺席断言经页面结构核查成立（截至 2026-10-31）。

title: 跟踪上游的反馈时距
issue: Netflix 个案页当事人语：“When we run FreeBSD-CURRENT, we catch things really fast. If there's some regression, we catch it right away.”＋“There's no two—or three-year delay between somebody committing something and us finding it's a problem.”——即时发现与“两三年”时距逐字命中。

title: 改动回传上游的惯例
issue: 同页：“It's crucial to reduce the divergence of your operating system to FreeBSD, which means that you need to upstream your changes.”——减分叉须回传上游逐字命中；另载“allowed us to collaborate with upstream developers and get our changes into FreeBSD quickly”。

title: 影响计量的口径问题
issue: 同页：“Netflix realized that when deploying a CDN at a global scale, even a single percentage point increase in performance results in savings worth hundreds of thousands of dollars.”——一个百分点值数十万美元逐字命中；题面“收益可计量而归属难计量”的方法论半句为编者引申。

title: 创新清单的归属判据
issue: innovations 页：“This is a list of software and ideas developed or maintained by the OpenBSD project”——归属判据（项目开发或维护）逐字命中。

title: 风格文本作为材料的一类
issue: style(9) 页内逐字：“This manual page was originally based on the src/admin/style/style file from the 4.4BSD-Lite2 release”——取自 4.4BSD-Lite2 之 src/admin/style/style 逐字命中，材料类自证成立。

title: 一手文本的选取标准
issue: 体例题（材料选取标准，无外部事实断言）；离线核查：本节材料（style(9)、各系官方自述页、Gabriel 自述两篇）均属项目自定规范或作者自述，与他方评述之别成立。

title: 自述材料的偏差控制
issue: 《The Rise of Worse is Better》逐字：“I have intentionally caricatured the worse-is-better philosophy to convince you that it is obviously a bad philosophy and that the New Jersey approach is a bad approach.”——自承有意漫画化逐字命中。精度注记：一手句点名的漫画化对象是 worse-is-better 哲学（与 New Jersey approach 一体两名），题面“两种哲学”宜收窄。

title: 比较单元的粒度设定
issue: OpenBSD goals 页逐字：“Obviously, each developer working on OpenBSD has their own aims and priorities, but it is possible to classify the goals we all share:”——“可分类的共同目标”与“不落到个人偏好”的对照逐字命中。

title: 结论边界的可核性
issue: Worse Is Better 页末句逐字：“Decide for yourselves.”——判断交回读者逐字命中；后半句为本卷编侧体例限定，无外部断言。

title: 材料的引入时间标记
issue: OpenBSD innovations 页逐字：“This is a list of software and ideas developed or maintained by the OpenBSD project, sorted in order of approximate introduction.”——按引入时间近似顺序编排逐字命中。

title: KNF 的风格祖本
issue: style(9) 页内逐字：“Based on the CSRG's KNF (Kernel Normal Form).”——取自 CSRG 内核常规形式逐字命中；HISTORY 又载其成文化自 Thompson 与 Ritchie，单一祖本线索闭合。

title: 风格法典的层层承袭
issue: style(9) 两句逐字：“This manual page was originally based on the src/admin/style/style file from the 4.4BSD-Lite2 release”；“…a codification by the CSRG of the programming style of Ken Thompson and Dennis Ritchie in Version 6 AT&T UNIX.”（句主语为 src/admin/style/style）——4.4BSD-Lite2 上溯 Thompson 与 Ritchie 的承袭链逐字命中。

title: 行宽与可读性的取舍
issue: 逐字：“The preferred line width is 80 characters, but some exceptions are made when a slightly longer line is clearer or easier to read.”——首选而非铁律、清晰可读可破例逐字命中。

title: 格式改动的下游负担
issue: 逐字：“Stylistic changes, including whitespace ones, complicate the work of downstream consumers and may impair developers' ability”（续句载追溯部分改动历史受损并劝免单独提交风格改动）——下游负担与历史追溯受损命中。

title: 示例先于条文的写法
issue: 逐字：“Many of the style rules are implicit in the examples. Be careful to check the examples before assuming that style is silent on an issue.”——规则藏于示例、读规范先读例逐字命中。

title: 风格检查的工具化
issue: FILES 节载 tools/build/checkstyle9.pl 逐字：“A script to check for violations of style in a source file.”——规范附检查脚本逐字命中；“部分判断可转为可执行检查”系编侧引申。

title: NetBSD 旗标的载体用途
issue: NetBSD 基金会 2004Q4 报告逐字：“The new logo, which features a flag, is used on the NetBSD.org website and will be used for software media, apparel, advertisements, promotional materials, and the NetBSD Foundation literature.”——官网／软件介质／服饰／广告／宣传品／基金会出版物六类载体逐字命中。

title: 换标与吉祥物的并存
issue: 同报告逐字：“It is worth noting, however, that the choice of a new logo does not mean the abandonment of the mascot, the beloved daemon.”——换标不弃吉祥物逐字命中。

title: BSD Daemon 图像的著作权归属
issue: FreeBSD“BSD Daemon”版权页逐字：“The copyright holder and creator of the daemon image is Marshall Kirk McKusick.”；“Permission to use the daemon may be obtained from:”——著作权与创作归属及使用须许可逐字命中。

title: 视觉更新的征集程序
issue: 同报告逐字：“The logo was selected out of over 400 submissions by 238 artists.”；“Members of the NetBSD Foundation voted for the new logo from a short-list of six submitted designs selected by the logo committee.”——征集与会员投票逐字命中。精度注记：该报告未自述征件是否公开，题面“公开征集”之“公开”宜另引 2004 年征件公告为证（本批未取）。

title: BSD Daemon 在多页中的反复出现
issue: 同页首句逐字：“The little red fellow that graces many of these pages is the BSD Daemon.”——同一形象反复出现逐字命中。精度注记：原文为 many（许多），题面“多数页面”系加码，正文宜写“许多页面”。

title: DragonFly 名称的蜻蜓照片来源
issue: DragonFly 史页逐字：“The original photograph that inspired the name:”（下接图档 mascot.jpg）——名称取自一张照片且照片载于史页逐字命中；“蜻蜓”未目验图档，系由“启发 DragonFly 之名”推证。

title: 集会形式的无议程安排
issue: hackathons 页逐字：“In our form, hackathons do not have talks, nor a specific schedule.”；“People will arrive at a hackathon to work for a straight stretch of time on the projects they wish to, in the same room as the people who they need to talk to about their ideas.”——无演讲无日程、到场连续写代码逐字命中。

title: 首届集会的实物纪念
issue: 同页首届集会（c99，1999 年 6 月，Calgary）段逐字：“…an accidental scrape in a hardwood floor commemorates the event.”——地板刮痕作该次集会纪念物逐字命中。

title: 纪念物的分配办法
issue: 同页逐字：“The shirts are only given to people who attend the event, and are worn with pride.”——纪念衫只发给到场者逐字命中；“分配规则即成员边界”系编侧引申。

title: 发行歌曲的配属形式
issue: lyrics 页逐字：“Every 6 months the OpenBSD project has the pleasure to release our software with artwork and possibly a matching song.”；“Three audio CDs have been made which contain approximately 5 years of songs each”——六个月发行配美术品与歌曲、歌曲结集为唱片逐字命中。

title: 邮件格式的明文与列宽
issue: mail.html Netiquette 节逐字：“Plain text, 72 characters per line.”——纯文本、每行七十二字符逐字命中。

title: 仪式与工作的分际
issue: 同页逐字：“Hackathons are about writing code.”——集会自述以写代码为目的逐字命中；“仪式不取代产出”系编侧引申。

title: 两种设计哲学的分野
issue: 《The Rise of Worse is Better》逐字：“The essence of this style can be captured by the phrase the right thing.”（承前句 the MIT/Stanford style of design）；优先序对照：MIT 侧“It is more important for the interface to be simple than the implementation.”对新泽西侧“It is more important for the implementation to be simple than the interface.”——分野逐字命中。精度注记：“the right thing”系文作者之概括命名，题面“自我命名”宜写“被命名为”。

title: 简洁优先的条文表述
issue: 新泽西清单逐字：“Simplicity is the most important consideration in a design.”；“It is more important for the implementation to be simple than the interface.”——简洁列为最重要、实现简单优先于接口简单逐字命中。

title: 自嘲笔法的解读分寸
issue: 逐字：“I have intentionally caricatured the worse-is-better philosophy to convince you that it is obviously a bad philosophy and that the New Jersey approach is a bad approach.”——自承有意漫画化逐字命中；贬词当修辞读成立。

title: 新泽西之名的出处与例证
issue: 逐字：“Early Unix and C are examples of the use of this school of design, and I will call the use of this design strategy the New Jersey approach.”；Worse Is Better 页自述戏称：“…referring to the humorous name I gave to the worse-is-better approach to design.”——出处、用例、戏称三段逐字命中。

title: Unix 与 C 的病毒比喻
issue: 逐字：“Unix and C are the ultimate computer viruses.”——终极计算机病毒比喻逐字命中。

title: 算法简洁的自述语汇
issue: DragonFly 主页逐字：“The community also takes pride in its openness and innovative spirit, applying patience liberally and always trying to find a means to meet or exceed the performance of our competitors while maintaining our trademark algorithmic simplicity.”——商标式算法简洁列为持续保持的特征逐字命中。

title: 设计者自述的可信度
issue: Worse Is Better 页逐字：“However, despite the apparent enthusiasm by the rest of the world, I was uneasy about the concept of worse is better, and especially with my association with it.”——自承与所论概念关系紧张逐字命中；“可信度打折”系编侧引申。

title: 接受者的条件化过程
issue: 逐字：“Therefore, the worse-is-better software first will gain acceptance, second will condition its users to expect less, and third will be improved to a point that is almost the right thing.”——接受心理三段逐字命中。

title: 四项品质的共识预设
issue: 四品质（Simplicity、Correctness、Consistency、Completeness）清单后逐字：“I believe most people would agree that these are good characteristics.”——四项品质共识预设逐字命中。

title: 材料边界的自我限定
issue: style(9) 逐字：“Many of the style rules are implicit in the examples. Be careful to check the examples before assuming that style is silent on an issue.”——规范自身处理“沉默”可能性成立。精度注记：一手句实义是“未查例不得假定规范沉默”，题面“读者不得据沉默作推论”与之有方向差，正文落笔宜按一手句原义。

title: 黑客民俗的心理真实性陈述
issue: TUHS 存档 1991-01-03 comp.unix.internals 帖（Jargon File v2.3.1 第 11 部分，Eric S. Raymond 贴）附录 B Religion 节逐字：“Hacker folklore that pays homage to `wizards' and speaks of incantations and demons has too much psychological truthfulness about it to be entirely a joke.”——1991 年帖文与心理真实性表述逐字命中。

title: 创作者意图与结果的偏差
issue: 逐字：“The lesson to be learned from this is that it is often undesirable to go for the right thing first. It is better to get half of the right thing available so that it spreads like a virus.”——“先取对物之半”逐字命中；“意图与结果并不一致”系编侧引申。

title: 审美主张与生存能力的抵触
issue: 逐字：“However, I believe that worse-is-better, even in its strawman form, has better survival characteristics than the-right-thing, and that the New Jersey approach when used for software is a better approach than the MIT approach.”——生存上更有利逐字命中；与同文前句“obviously a bad philosophy”之漫画化声明对峙，抵触为文本自证。

title: 重构收益的事后评价
issue: DragonFly 史页逐字：“This work was originally intended to support single system image clustering, but has had the effect of making the kernel much more reliable, understandable and easily maintainable.”——原定集群能力、事后追认可靠与可维护逐字命中。

title: 审计收益的递减陈述
issue: security 页逐字（承前句审计叙事）：“Hence most of the security problems that we encountered were fixed before our 2.1 release, and then a far smaller number needed fixing for our 2.2 release. We do not find as many problems anymore, it is simply a case of diminishing returns.”——收益递减自述逐字命中；“为批评留出空间”系编侧引申。

title: 默认安装的远程漏洞计数
issue: 首页现行口号逐字：“Only two remote holes in the default install, in a heck of a long time!”——对外说法逐字命中。精度注记：本批仅证实现行页面在挂，口号沿革未考，“长期”宜注时点。

title: 外部评语对该文的判语
issue: Worse Is Better 页末引语逐字：“The classic essay on "worse is better" is either misunderstood or wrong.”——署名 Jim Waldo，位于页面末，判语逐字命中。

title: 批评与自我批评的对称
issue: 同页逐字：“This piece attacked worse is better.”；“…later I would bring them rebuttals (as Nickieben) against myself”——1991—92 冬以化名 Nickieben Bourbaki 撰“Worse Is Better Is Worse”攻击自家主张，同页自述与自辩互证，批评为内部程序。

title: Unix 哲学法则的条目化
issue: TAOUP ch01s06 十七法则实序为“1. Rule of Modularity: Write simple parts connected by clean interfaces.”居首、“5. Rule of Simplicity: Design for simplicity; add complexity only where you must.”列第五——题面“简洁居首条”与一手序次相悖；条目化本身成立（十七条）。若拟改锚 Gancarz“Small is beautiful”居首说，须另取证（本批未取）。〔已采纳落账 2026-10-31〕
suggested_title: Unix 哲学法则的条目化与简洁法则

title: 简洁法则的工程信条
issue: Rule of Simplicity 小节正文逐字：“The only way to avoid these traps is to encourage a software culture that knows that small is beautiful, that actively resists bloat and complexity: an engineering tradition that puts a high value on simple solutions”——“小即美”写成工程传统逐字命中。

title: 模块化法则的接口约定
issue: 逐字：“1. Rule of Modularity: Write simple parts connected by clean interfaces.”；正文“…to build it out of simple parts connected by well-defined interfaces, so that most problems are local and you can have some hope of upgrading a part without breaking the whole.”——清晰接口前提与复杂度局部化逐字命中。

title: 简约法则的规模限制
issue: 逐字：“6. Rule of Parsimony: Write a big program only when it is clear by demonstration that nothing else will do.”——大程序须经论证方可写逐字命中。

title: 大程序的可维护性代价
issue: Rule of Parsimony 正文逐字：“Allowing programs to get large hurts maintainability. Because people are reluctant to throw away the visible product of lots of work, large programs invite overinvestment in approaches that are failed or suboptimal.”——可维护性受损与失败／次优方案过度投入逐字命中。

title: 例外条款与通则的关系
issue: style(9) 行宽条逐字：“The preferred line width is 80 characters, but some exceptions are made when a slightly longer line is clearer or easier to read.”——通则加例外、例外条款可引成立。精度注记：题面“规范”未点名；TAOUP 十七法则清单并无例外条款，正文须写明所论规范为 style(9)。

title: 正确之物的概念命名
issue: 逐字：“The essence of this style can be captured by the phrase the right thing.”（承前句 the MIT/Stanford style of design）——“正确之物”作为该风格的名称逐字命中。
